controls.scope: Nominal intrinsic dimension ratios only; all real currents, voltages and timing require the original full transient gates.

parent_headroom.scope: Nominal current-density projection only; candidate MOS/nonlinear HBT currents and narrow VCE headroom require all original native bounds. No projected pass.

intrinsic_screen.diffusion_model_scope: Same declared single-finger0.34um diffusion hypothesis: recomputed area/perimeter for45um/67.5um widths. Not extracted geometry.
intrinsic_screen.scope: Only32 actual sampler tail MOS widths and32 actual collector/bleed resistor lengths change from v44l39. All HBT sizes, dividers, followers, other devices, sourcebits, clocks, external biases,150fF/50fF loads, full34.25ns and every original bound remain. Nominal current/resistance compensation is a hypothesis, not a verified swing or speed improvement. Candidate requires real GDS/DRC/LVS/fresh RC/PVT/loop qualification.
